score_note: Open-source Vital; install from your distribution.
description: The open-source core of the Vital wavetable synthesizer, built without Vital's factory content, as part of DISTRHO Ports. There is no binary download: install it from your distribution, then it appears in the Instruments tab.
name: Vitalium

linux-x86_64.distro_hint: Packaged as vitalium-vst3 or distrho-ports on Arch (AUR), KXStudio and some Debian-based distributions.
linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: No binary release exists. Install the distribution package, then Slimphonic finds it. It starts without Vital's factory presets.
